description: This file contains a Python module for interacting with a LiteLLM PostgreSQL database, including functions for retrieving usage data, table info, and schema discovery, with a focus on the LiteLLM-specific tables.

classes.name: LiteLLMDatabase
classes.description: Handles database connections and queries for LiteLLM, including data retrieval and schema discovery.

methods.name: _ensure_prisma_client
methods.description: Ensures that the Prisma client is available for database operations.

methods.name: get_usage_data
methods.description: Retrieves usage data from the LiteLLM daily user spend table, with optional time filtering and limit.

methods.name: get_table_info
methods.description: Provides metadata about the LiteLLM daily user spend table, including row count and schema.

methods.name: _get_table_row_count
methods.description: Returns the row count for a specified table.

methods.name: discover_all_tables
methods.description: Discovers all LiteLLM tables and their schemas, including columns, primary keys, foreign keys, indexes, and row counts.
